chapter: Philadelphia and the McRae Brothers Band, 1908-1929
title: Born in Philadelphia; the McRae family and brothers
summary: McRae gives his name, says he was born in Philadelphia in 1908, and names his brothers and sister; his father was a real estate man.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, my full name was not my stage -- I'll say this. My name is Theodore McRae, "M-c-R-a-e. My stage name is Teddy, T-e-d-d-y M-c-R-a-e. Is that capital R? Capital R, yes. I was born in Philadelphia in 1908. My family is from Atlanta. They moved some time ago, and I was practically raised in Philly, and since I had six
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

other brothers and one sister. She was the baby sister. My oldest brother was named William McRae. My second oldest brother was named Floyd McRae. Dave McRae is my third oldest brother. I came after Dave, then Bob McRae who was called Robert McRae, was my youngest brother. My sister was in-between myself and Bob, the youngest one -- youngest brother. We raised in Philly, went to school there. My father was -- moved from Atlanta early in life, and he worked around Philly as a real estate man. We own quite a lot of property around Philly.
In the city itself or outside?
